title: Geo-enabled Logistics Platform
summary: Design the PostgreSQL data system for a regional on-demand logistics platform that owns courier, vehicle, delivery, service-zone, breadcrumb, and SLA data while dispatch remains off-platform.
critical_queries: Find top-N eligible couriers inside a service zone.
Report daily SLA performance by zone.
Replay courier breadcrumbs for a bounded time window.
Search delivery notes with core full-text search.
Identify breadcrumb partitions that are ready for retention action.

security_posture.tenant_isolation: Regional operator data is separated by region_id and service-zone ownership.
security_posture.extensions: PostGIS and pg_partman now; pgvector explicitly rejected for this workload.

operational_notes: The design must justify PostGIS, pg_partman-managed breadcrumb partitions, GiST spatial indexes, core FTS, and pg_stat_statements triage.
